decisions.statement: The reading is the gigabytes of memory the kernel says are available.
A gigabyte here is a kernel kilobyte over a thousand and twenty-four squared.
Memory the kernel could reclaim counts as available rather than as gone.
A reading is kept to a tenth of a gigabyte.
How much memory the workstation has in all is no part of the reading.
A meminfo naming no available memory is no reading rather than zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a share into a color.

definition: how much memory the kernel says the workstation still has to give
